title: NEW SERIES! An 8-part sketch series exploring the highs and lows of having a human brain!

author: Viva La Dirt League
description:
An 8-part sketch series exploring the highs and lows of having a human brain. From the lighthearted to the genuinely grim, nothing is off-limits. It’s an honest, comedic look at the mental health struggles we all face but rarely talk about.

If you're struggling with your mental health, please seek help. Here are some worldwide resources that could help:
https://nz.movember.com/mens-health/get-support (other markets replace ''nz'' with au, ca, us, uk etc)
https://www.who.int/news-room/feature-stories/mental-well-being-resources-for-the-public
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_suicide_crisis_lines
https://unitedgmh.org/mental-health-support
https://www.helpguide.org/find-help.htm

Made with the support of NZ On Air.
